jobs.occupation: Principal Engineer Package Concept Engineering (f/m/div) - HRC1870725 (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life.What if your ideas could change the way the world connects, powers up, or thinks?As a Principal Engineer Package Concept Engineering in our Research & Development team, you will have the opportunity to merge creativity with your technical expertise by shaping the future of technology, driving groundbreaking projects, and bringing new ideas to life. Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Developing and refining innovative package concepts for powering AI computing, with a focus on modules - Validating the concepts using **simulations **and hardware demonstrators in collaboration with backend and product development teams and system architects - Developing new ideas and assembly concepts in collaboration with backend development (in-house + OSAT) and initiating early-stage development projects to advance our packaging development - Supporting development projects through to market launch Identifying and integrating technological trends into the overarching packaging roadmap- Advising customers on packaging-specific issues and continuously monitoring the market to develop innovative business strategiesYour profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed - A degree in electrical engineering, physics, materials science, or an equivalent field - At least 6 years of professional experience in package technology and several years of hands-on experience in assembly technologies, as well as in-depth knowledge of backend processes, materials, and their interrelationships—ideally with knowledge of SMT-related technologies- Experience working with design tools such as AutoCAD or Cadence - Ability to solve complex problems by proactively engaging a network of experts- Willingness to travel occasionally to visit customers and suppliers - Ability to communicate and present fluently in German and English#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. jobs.description: html Expert R&D Automation and Data Management (m/f/d)Become part of a vital chain and contribute to our common goal of making people’s lives better. Octapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing medicines sourced from human plasma and human cell lines. We are a privately-owned company, where the warmth of family meets the scale of a global organisation.Octapharma Biopharmaceuticals GmbH with more than 200 employees is a subsidiary of the Octapharma group founded in 1997 and successfully expanding. Our core business is the development of recombinant proteins produced in human cell lines for therapeutic use in humans. We strive for effective treatments with an improved tolerability and convenience for our patients.Join us in shaping our vision to provide new health solutions advancing human life.We are looking for anExpert R&D Automation and Data Management (m/f/d)to join the Automation and Data Management unit within the Research and Development Department at Octapharma Biopharmaceuticals GmbH.The Automation and Data Management unit is responsible for the development, evaluation and long-term maintenance of automation- and data-driven solutions across R&D. The unit supports scientific projects by combining laboratory automation, data management, bioinformatics and scientific computing, and is involved in the work of multiple research units and virtually all projects within the department.The successful candidate will take on a challenging and versatile role with a strong focus on scientific computing, molecular modelling and high-performance computing (HPC). The position combines the application of computational methods to biological research questions with hands-on responsibility for the administration and strategic development of on-site Linux-based HPC infrastructure. Working closely with interdisciplinary research teams from all R&D units and Corporate IT, the candidate will ensure reliable and secure HPC operations while developing computational solutions to support scientific research. The role also includes contributions to internal data science and machine learning projects, with opportunities to develop expertise in new scientific and technical areas.Your main tasks and responsibilities- Development and application of molecular modelling approaches and molecular dynamics simulations to support scientific research, including protein characterization and developability studies- Administration, maintenance, optimization and strategic development of a Linux-based HPC infrastructure, including workload management and operational reliability- Development and maintenance of scripts and robust, reproducible, scalable workflows for scientific data processing, modelling and analysis, including testing and documentation- Contribution to internal data science and machine learning projects, including the evaluation and application of new computational approaches- Scientific and technical support of interdisciplinary research teams, translating research requirements into suitable computational solutions- Contribution to the integration and further development of data management, scientific computing and laboratory automation workflowsYour expertise and ideal skill set- PhD in Life Sciences with a strong focus on Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Biophysics or a related scientific discipline; postdoctoral experience is considered a plus. Candidates with an M.Sc. and extensive, highly relevant professional experience may also be considered- Practical experience in molecular modelling and molecular dynamics simulations of biological systems; hands-on experience with Molecular Operating Environment (MOE) is highly desirable- Strong programming skills in Python, particularly in scientific computing, data processing and analysis- Proven experience administering Linux-based HPC or cluster environments, including SLURM or comparable workload management systems, with a sound understanding of performance optimization and the ability to troubleshoot independently- Experience in planning, extending or optimizing scientific computing infrastructure is considered a plus- Experience in laboratory automation or the integration of automated laboratory systems with data processing workflows is considered a plus- Interest in machine learning and willingness to explore new scientific and technical topics- Experience with electronic laboratory management systems, such as ELN, LIMS or sample management solutions (e.g. Benchling or comparable platforms), is considered a plus- Practical experience with version control systems and workflow automation (CI/CD); familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) is considered a plus- Independent and structured working style, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and excellent communication and collaboration skills in an interdisciplinary environment- Fluent English skills; jobs.employer_name: Technische Universität München (TUM),  Forschungs-Neutronenquelle Heinz Maier-Leibnitz ...
jobs.description: Technical University Munich operates the high flux Neutron Source Heinz Maier-Leibnitz (FRM II) located at the scientific campus in Garching, Germany. The neutron source itself, its research instruments as well as the irradiation facilities provide unique possibilities for the scientific and industrial use of neutron beams.TOFTOF is a neutron time-of-flight chopper spectrometer to study dynamic processes in hard and soft condensed matter. The main areas of application are from materials science, soft matter, biological or magnetic systems. After years of successful operation, the instrument will receive a significant technical upgrade in the coming years.For the further development and the operation of the instrument TOFTOF we invite applications for a full-time (40 h/week) scientist position (m/f/d) asInstrument Scientist Toftof (m/f/d) You will be responsible for the scientific oversight of the technical upgrade of the instrument TOFTOF and attend to its technical realisation.Your tasks include:Scientific lead of TOFTOF’s further developments, i.e. of the neutron transport and chopper system. Conceptual design and future development of the secondary spectrometer, including the neutron detectors. Demonstration of its performance for the intended scientific applications.Project lead for the technical realisation of the upgrade work packages at TOFTOFExperimental tests of instrument critical components to validate performanceMethod development in the area of neutron spectroscopyOperation of the instrument and scientific and technical support in user operationPursuit of own scientific projects using neutron spectroscopy methodsYour responsibility is focused on the instrument TOFTOF. In future, your tasks might include further instrumentation projects.PhD in physics, chemistry, materials science, or a related field.Strong background in neutron spectroscopy and hands-on experience with experimental techniques and instrumentation. Experience with polarized neutrons are an asset.Demonstrated ability to conduct instrumentation projects and operate complex scientific setups.Knowledge of scientific programming and data analysis (e.g. Python, C++, MATLAB) is required, experience with ray tracing simulation packages, e.g. McStas, are beneficial.Self-motivated and independent working style combined with the ability to work in an international and interdisciplinary team.Demonstrated ability to conduct independent scientific research and motivation to develop an own scientific research profilePersuasive communication skills and ability to work in a team in an international environment are mandatory. Good oral and written English skills are required, German language skills are an asset.For further information about the position, please contact Wiebke Lohstroh, E-Mail: wiebke.lohstroh@frm2.tum.deThe high safety standard of our facility requires the reliability of the employees according to German nuclear law. Appropriate reliability checks have to be performed for all employees.We offer flexible working hours, 30 days' vacation per year and a company pension plan (VBL). As an employee of FRM II, you can benefit from many other TUM offers, such asTUM's health offersUniversity sportsTUM's internal continuing education and training opportunitiesTUM childcare (subject to availability)Very good accessibility by public transportThe position is remunerated according to TV-L and limited to 3 years. The position is suitable for severely disabled people. Severely disabled applicants will be given preference if they otherwise have essentially the same suitability, qualifications and professional performance. TUM aims to increase the proportion of women. Applications from women are therefore expressly welcomed.

IntroductionATworld, operated by Simplify Places GmbH, is redefining the way we work and connect.We offer a flexible, connected, and ownable 'fourth space' - a dynamic ecosystem where individuals and companies can access resources, services, and communities anytime, anywhere.Supported today by hotels and offices owned by Aroundtown, ATworld is rapidly expanding across Europe and partnering with external locations such as hotels, cafés, and coworking spaces. We are committed to proving that doing good and doing well can go hand in hand.Backed by Aroundtown - one of Europe’s leading real estate companies - ATworld has the resources and scale to pioneer the future of work.Your responsibilitiesOnboarding and listings- Take partners from signed contract to live: create listings, hold the onboarding call with an app demo, set the location live.- Keep listings accurate, maintaining consistency and quality across the app.- Work with the team lead together to improve existing processes, to then prepare the operations for growthAccount management- Be our partners’ point of contact and build relationships ensuring their success with ATworld.- Consult them on the listing, offering, and potential initiatives to increase bookings, visibility, and/or payout.- Maintain a regular contact strategy and review booking as well as feedback reports.- Review the partner reconciliation report to check the payouts.Partner support- Handle partner requests on bookings, content, and listing changes.- Keep response times visible and improve them where you can.- Turn repeat questions into a clear SOP or a better listing flow.Systems, quality, and reporting- Work in HubSpot every day: pipeline, tasks, tickets, and activity on the account.- Review our bookings and feedback report, spot patterns and opportunities that will improve our members’ experience on site. Who we are looking for- 2–3 years in account management, partner or customer success, hospitality operations, coworking, or a similar marketplace / supply role.- You're an excellent communicator, both in writing and verbally. You can explain complex topics in a simple, clear, and friendly manner. You are comfortable speaking on the phone and in person with out partners.- Highly organized & proactive: You can juggle multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment without losing sight of the details. You don't wait to be told what to do; you actively look for ways to help.- You’re tech-savvy and comfortable using various software and back-office systems for managing data and content. - You're detail-oriented and thorough in your work, ensuring consistent quality in the projects you are working on.- You are curious about how to make a repeatable process better.- Berlin-Based: You are located in Berlin and are excited about a hybrid role that combines remote work with in-person collaboration.- Comfortable working with a CRM, HubSpot is a plus.- Fluent in German and English.- A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field is a plus.What we offer- Working from all the different ATworld locations.- Being part of a fun, dynamic, and international team.- Real impact. You can shape the processes, production, and decisions that are made.- Flat hierarchy, so you will be working very closely with the leadership of the team.Contact informationIf you are interested, we are looking forward to your application!For any questions, feel free to reach out to Esther Köhne at esther.koehne@thisisatworld.com.Looking forward to meeting you!

jobs.description: For over 80 years, at ERBACHER the food family we have been developing innovative solutions in animal nutrition for livestock and pets, as well as producing high-quality food, made possible by the dedication of our teams in Germany, Ukraine, Tanzania, and Poland.Step by step, we turn ideas into innovations that have a real impact on everyday life, and every project is based on collaboration, mutual respect, and commitment. At ERBACHER the food family, we believe in a good tomorrow… and we create it.We are looking for people who want to create a good tomorrow together with us.Responsibilities- Lead and support the P&C Business Partners team through regular feedback and coaching.- Build trusted relationships with leaders, advise them on key people matters and connect them with P&C teams.- Help leaders turn business goals into clear people and team actions.- Manage conflicts and sensitive situations fairly and discreetly, involving Legal or other experts, when required.- Promote a culture based on trust, accountability and open communication.- Ensure effective management of employee and labour-related matters and ongoing process improvement.Requirements:- 3+ years’ HR/P&C Business Partner experience.- Degree in HR, business, law, psychology or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.- Good understanding of workforce planning, including skills, capacity, succession and hiring needs.- Solid knowledge of German employment law, HR processes and data protection.- Experience in collaboration with German works council.- Initial people-leadership or team-coordination experience.- Experience in cross-teams collaboration, including working with Talent Acquisition, People Operations, Development & Engagement, Legal and Corporate Communication teams.- Strong communication, coaching, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills.- C1/C2-level English and willingness to work from the office at least 3 days per week.What You Can ExpectPeople are at the heart of everything we do. We encourage individual talents and create an environment where everyone can contribute, bring ideas to life and work effectively as part of a team.What exactly can you expect from us?- Innovative, creative, and sometimes unconventional ways of thinking and working.- A wide range of development and training opportunities, as well as various language courses.- Flexible working arrangements and remote working.- A varied and challenging role with room to shape things, and the opportunity to have a say and put ideas into practice.- Flexible working hours – additional vacation days - Christmas and vacation bonuses.- Occupational pension scheme and accident insurance - bonus.- Sports, mobility, and health benefits.- Free muesli, fruit, and vegetables.- Healthy, subsidized lunches.- We support e-mobility with charging stations at our headquarters and the option to lease an electric vehicle.- Work - and enjoy team events together - in an international environment with colleagues from Poland, Germany, Tanzania, and Ukraine.- Ongoing professional and personal development through tailored training and development programs.- An inspiring, supportive atmosphere and modern working conditions, with tools and technologies that support your development and help you work more efficiently.*What matters is that we’re a good fit. We are a small, focused team committed to solving hard problems with engineering excellence. All team members are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All team members are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

The CompanyUndagrid is part of the EnOcean group and delivers end-to-end asset tracking and IoT solutions that give customers in aviation, logistics and industry full visibility of their assets, equipment and operations. The Undagrid platform combines self-powered and battery-driven sensor devices with BLE-based indoor positioning, GPS/GNSS outdoor tracking and cellular IoT connectivity, and turns the resulting data into dashboards, analytics and reports that customers rely on every day. We are the leader in sensing and control products for IoT infrastructures and combine it with energy harvesting technologies for maintenance-free solutions that gain their energy from the environment enabling a sustainable world.The Role & YouYou are the technical face of our asset tracking platform towards our worldwide customer base. Working side by side with Sales, Product Management and Engineering, you guide customers from the first platform demonstration through deployment, training and day-to-day operations, and make sure they get measurable value out of our solutions. As an integral part of a global Customer Success team, you combine hands-on platform expertise with a strong feel for our customers’ business processes, and you turn what you learn in the field into better products.This position can be based in either Munich (Germany) , Copenhagen (Denmark) or Utrecht (the Netherlands) . We are recruiting for one role and will hire one candidate . The employment contract will be concluded with the local EnOcean entity at the selected location. Please apply only once and indicate your preferred location.#LI-HybridWhat you’ll be doing• Act as the primary technical counterpart in customer meetings alongside Sales and PM, and build strong relationships with technical, operational and management stakeholders on the customer side• Deliver compelling platform demonstrations and showcase advanced functionality in a way that creates confidence and excitement with customers• Support solution design and deployment planning for new customer projects, and support our customers worldwide in deploying EnOcean and Undagrid solutions in their network and IT infrastructure• Configure and administer the platform independently, including tenant creation, user management, dashboard setup, reporting and minor customizations to meet customer requirements• Deliver technical and operational training for customer teams, from end users to administrators and IT stakeholders• Travel to customer sites when needed to support deployments, training, workshops, troubleshooting and business reviews• Validate our solutions in the field and at customer sites, identify technical problems and drive them to resolution• Collect customer requirements and translate them into actionable improvements and product feedback, working closely with our sales, product marketing, product management and engineering teamsWhat we’re looking for• BSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or a relevant field, combined with 5–10 years of experience in the asset tracking, IoT, RTLS, telematics, or related industries• Solid understanding of both indoor and outdoor tracking technologies: BLE-based indoor positioning and proximity tracking, GPS/GNSS-based outdoor tracking, as well as cellular IoT, telematics and fleet tracking concepts• Experience working with asset tracking platforms, dashboards, analytics and customer reporting, as well as with tools such as Grafana, git and Jira• Experience in installing and configuring network equipment, ideally in the field of aviation or logistics• Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving skills across hardware, connectivity and software domains• Good understanding of business processes and operational use cases, enabling you to discuss both technical capabilities and business value with customers• Ability to communicate effectively with everyone from operational users and IT departments to senior management, paired with a hands-on, problem-solving attitude in direct customer contact• Willingness to travel worldwide and to adjust your working schedule to support customers in different time zones• Fluent English is a must, additional language skills are a plusWhat we offer and what you can expect• Flexible working hours, well balanced work-life ratio• Work in an international and interdisciplinary team with great spirit• Freedom to express and develop yourself• Be part of a company that develops innovative technology for a greener world

jobs.occupation: SoftwareOne Deutschland GmbH: Regional Services Leader (gn) DACH (IT-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Job FunctionServicesWarum SoftwareOne?SoftwareOne ist ein globaler Anbieter und Distributor von Software- und Cloud-Lösungen. Rund 12.000 Menschen in mehr als 70 Ländern sind Teil von SoftwareOne. Was uns wirklich ausmacht, sind jedoch unsere Mitarbeitenden: neugierige Köpfe, unterschiedliche Perspektiven und talentierte Teams, die gemeinsam Lösungen entwickeln und etwas bewegen. Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, dich weiterzuentwickeln, Neues zu entdecken und deinen eigenen Karriereweg zu gestalten. Gleichzeitig trägst du dazu bei, die technologische Zukunft voranzutreiben.Die Rolle- Do you want to lead a high-impact Services organization that connects local execution with global collaboration and directly influences our customers’ experience?  - Are you ready to take ownership of SoftwareOne’s Services delivery across DACH and shape strategic customer outcomes?  Practical information  Location: Germany, Switzerland or Austria | Reports to: Regional President DACH | Team: Regional Services Delivery | Work arrangement: Hybrid | Language requirements: Fluent/Professional level English and German, written and verbal. Visa Requirements: Valid visa for DACH region.     Leading a Services organisation of around 650 people and a substantial Services P&L across DACH, you will align regional execution with the company operating model, strengthen collaboration between Services and Sales, and build the leadership capability needed to scale high-quality delivery across the region. This leadership role combines business ownership, service delivery excellence, operational performance, and strategic growth across the DACH region. Key responsibilities include:- Leading the successful delivery of Professional, Managed, and Support Services across DACH, ensuring consistent execution, customer satisfaction, and alignment with global governance standards.- Optimising regional, remote, and partner delivery capabilities to balance customer outcomes, scalability, operational efficiency, and profitable growth.- Driving customer adoption, transformation outcomes, and long-term value realisation while ensuring services deliver measurable business impact.- Owning regional Services performance, including P&L, forecasting, revenue recognition, delivery costs, investments, operational KPIs, and financial targets.- Partnering with Sales, Marketing, Alliances, vendors, and executive customer stakeholders to grow the Services business and drive successful delivery of strategic engagements.- Leading proactive risk, escalation, SLA, and governance management to protect customer satisfaction, business performance, and commercial outcomes.- Driving innovation, automation, standardisation, and continuous improvement to enhance delivery quality, productivity, and scalability.- Aligning regional execution with portfolio strategy, strategic growth priorities, and the Centres of Excellence framework.- Building and developing high-performing leadership teams, strengthening succession, talent development, collaboration, and knowledge sharing.- Acting as a visible executive leader and role model, fostering a culture of accountability, customer focus, performance, and continuous improvement.Kenntnisse und FähigkeitenWe are looking for a senior services leader with the commercial depth, delivery discipline, and executive presence to scale a complex regional Services business. You bring: - Demonstrated experience leading large-scale Professional, Managed, and Support Services organisations, with accountability for business performance, operational excellence, and sustainable growth.- A strong commercial mindset, with the ability to drive revenue, profitability, customer satisfaction, and strategic business outcomes in a complex services environment.- Proven success building, developing, and inspiring high-performing leadership teams across multiple countries, locations, and cultures.- The ability to influence and align senior stakeholders across Sales, Delivery, Country Leadership, strategic partners, and vendors to achieve shared objectives and accelerate business success.- Deep expertise in scaling and optimising service delivery organisations, leveraging market insights, modern delivery practices, and strong Go-to-Market collaboration to drive customer value and business growth. Das haben wir zu bietenOur employees are our most valuable asset, and because of that we work actively on creating an environment where you can feel at home and thrive: - Varying tasks with scope for creativity and development in an internationally connected environment - Flexible working with the option to work from home - Time for new perspectives: the option of a sabbatical or workation - Embracing diversity through equal opportunities, our DEIB strategy, and the Women in Tech initiative - Structured onboarding with a personal buddy from day one and tailored learning and development opportunities You can find all country-specific benefits here:  - Benefits Deutschland - Benefits Schweiz - Benefits Österreich Schlagworte: Services, Englisch, Softwareentwicklung, servicemanagement, Servicemanagement, service-management, Service-management, Softwareentwickler, webservice, Webservice, AI, Support, support, Webentwickler, Systemingenieur, KI, Go, Anwendungsentwicklung, Anwendungsentwickler, softwaredevelopment, EmpfehlungsbundQuelle/Bewerbung via: https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/308160/regional-services-leader-gn-dach (https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/308160/regional-services-leader-gn-dach#apply_form)Kurzinfo zum UnternehmenSoftwareOne ist ein führender Anbieter von Software- und Cloud-Lösungen. Unser Ziel ist es, die Art und Weise, wie Unternehmen ihre Cloud planen, betreiben oder darüber beschaffen, neu zu definieren. Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden bei der Migration sowie Modernisierung ihrer Workloads und Anwendungen und stehen ihnen bei der Optimierung der daraus resultierenden Software- und Cloud-Änderungen beratend zur Seite. Somit erschließen wir den gesamten Mehrwert der Cloud-Technologien für unsere Kunden.Homeoffice:Umfang: Maximal 100%

Director Global Quality (m/f/x)Wieland-Werke AG I Ulm I Business Unit Thermal Solutions I Ident. Code 2026-0154 I immediatelyUnleash potential.Copper connects the world - in technologies, such as eMobility, energy and data transfer, refrigeration and air conditioning technology, digitalization and the Internet of Things. Surprise us with your fresh thinking, new impulses and shape the world of tomorrow. Discover numerous opportunities to unleash your potential.Wieland stands for diversity and equal opportunities - for this reason, we welcome individual applications regardless of age, gender, nationality, religion, ethnic and social background.Director Global Quality (m/f/x) Your FutureIn this newly created key leadership role, you will shape the development of a globally aligned quality organization and support sustainable international growth. Together with our manufacturing sites around the world, you will establish global quality standards, drive the digital transformation of our quality organization and ensure consistently high product quality across our international operations.- Strategy: As Director Global Quality (m/f/d), you will define and drive the global quality strategy for our Thermal Solutions Business Unit. You will establish a unified quality framework across our international manufacturing sites and align them around shared quality objectives.- Transformation: You will play a key role in shaping the future of our global quality organization. By harmonizing quality systems, processes and standards, you will build a scalable organization that supports international growth and the successful integration of newly acquired sites.- Digitalization: You will drive the digital transformation of our quality management processes by implementing modern Quality Management Systems (QMS) and data-driven performance management tools, increasing transparency, efficiency and operational excellence across all locations.- Operational Excellence: You will manage global quality KPIs, lead cross-functional continuous improvement initiatives and foster a culture of operational excellence across the entire organization, ensuring sustainable performance improvements.- Global Collaboration: Working closely with our manufacturing sites as well as cross-functional teams in Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain and other business functions, you will establish globally aligned quality standards and successfully integrate new sites into our global quality framework.- Customer Focus: Together with our global teams, you will ensure outstanding quality throughout the entire product lifecycle. By enabling successful new product introductions, reducing scrap rates and enhancing customer satisfaction, you will create measurable value for our customers worldwide.Your Potential- Education: You hold a Master's degree in Quality Management, Operations, Engineering or a comparable field.- Leadership: You bring extensive leadership experience in global quality management within an international manufacturing environment and are experienced in operating within a matrix organization.- Transformation Expertise: You have successfully led international transformation and standardization initiatives and have a proven track record of developing global quality organizations.- Technical Expertise: You possess in-depth knowledge of modern Quality Management Systems and Lean Management, complemented by strong analytical, strategic and systemic thinking.- Personality: You are an empathetic and inspiring leader with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of bringing people together and driving sustainable change across international organizations.- Language: You communicate fluently in German and English. Italian or French language skills are considered an advantage.- Mobility: You enjoy working in an international environment and are willing to travel globally to collaborate closely with our manufacturing sites and stakeholders worldwide.Your Benefits- A Great Place to Work: Join a motivated team where collaboration, mutual respect and a positive working atmosphere are part of our everyday culture.- Comprehensive Benefits: Benefit from an attractive package including a company pension scheme, childcare support, Christmas gifts for employees' children, employee appreciation gifts, subsidized meals in our company restaurant with healthy food options, and a wide range of employee discounts.- Health & Well-being: Your health matters to us. We support your well-being through a variety of initiatives, including Wellpass, our in-house health program ("Vitalwerkstatt") and company sports groups.- Health Services: We care about your physical and mental well-being. Our on-site occupational physicians and medical team are available whenever you need support. You also benefit from our orthopedic express service and free, confidential employee assistance program, offering professional advice and support for both work-related and personal matters – including your immediate family members.Interested?I am happy to answer your questions by email: recruiting@wieland.comMs Marina TikvicApplypowered by d.vinci

Our diverse teams collaborate across Europe, bringing different perspectives together as ONECompany, driven by a shared goal: creating solutions that truly make a difference.You already have hands-on experience in project environments and are ready to take the next step in your project management career? The bess group is a medium-sized, owner-managed business with an international presence, manufacturing sites in Berlin and Dußlingen (Germany), the United States and France, and around 200 members of staff.As manufacturers and distributors of implants, instruments and innovative device systems, we serve clients across the fields of ENT, head and neck surgery, pulmonology and gastroenterology. For over 35 years, we have also been providing custom-made devices and supporting medical innovation, building a reputation as highly competent and valued partners.
